_comment: Where the update check asks, and the limits it asks under. The source is the repository's
release page, which answers with a redirect to the newest tag; that redirect is the whole
answer and it is not followed, so this check reads no body and asks for no notes. The
request carries nothing the reader owns: no key, no auth header, no query, no install
identifier, and no words or selection text. A source that is not https is refused and nothing
is sent at all. The limits are the ceiling on one answer: a check that hangs or grows
without bound is a check the reader pays for on every start. Nothing is downloaded,
installed or run -- the card opens the release page and stops there.
